plan.title: Donation Performance and Donor Analytics
plan.subtitle: Monthly donation trends, geographic distribution, payment modes, and repeat donor activity

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Total Transactions
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tx FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Repeat Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_donors FROM (SELECT COALESCE("PAN", "Email", "Donor") AS donor_id FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', try_strptime("Date", '%Y-%m-%d')) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top Cities by Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "City" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Mode Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Mode" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top Repeat Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE("Donor", 'Anonymous') AS donor_name, COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_contributed, MAX("Date") AS last_donation_date FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: Across all records, total collections reached {{p1.total_amount}} across {{p2.total_tx}} transactions. A core segment of {{p3.repeat_donors}} repeat donors continues to contribute regularly. Monthly trends track overall inflows over time, while city and payment mode breakdowns highlight top regional and channel sources.
